description: This source file manages platform-specific upgrade procedures for the OpenWrt firmware on a device using NAND flash. It defines functions to check the image, perform upgrades, and handle partition switching based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the firmware image for the current platform.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles performing the firmware upgrade, including determining the current boot partition and switching to the alternate partition for the next boot.
